transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because the men at the domino table—and sometimes the radio announcer—give little messages meant for me. My wife says it’s just ordinary talk, but I know they’re warning me to be careful.
How long have you been noticing these messages?
On and off, it’s been about nine months now—the voices and those special messages.
Over these past nine months, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?
I’m not sure I’d say I’ve been persistently down. I have my days, but not all the time.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical or neurological illnesses, or had any major head injuries?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had any major head injury that I know of.
Do you ever hear voices speaking when there is no one around and no television or radio is playing?
Yes. Some afternoons when the house is quiet, I hear my old friend calling my name from the porch, or humming a choir song. It sounds clear, like he’s standing right there.
